Process declarative material operations (--search), including
resource search, video-frame derivation, music-beat analysis,
standalone ASR, TTS generation, then import
a local media file (--import). Search-only processing can also
return JSON without a workspace.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --workspace TEXT    Blueprint workspace directory. Optional for search-only --search
                              requests; frame/beat/ASR/understand/SAM3 processing requires it.
                              When omitted search results are returned without writing
                              resource_map.json. The directory is created as needed for
                              resource writes.
          --search TEXT       JSON describing material operations (`search`, `generate`,
                              `frame`, `beats`, `asr`, `understand`, `sam3_region_discover`,
                              optional `concurrency`, and optional `doc_filter`). Concurrency
                              values for each processing lane must be integers from 1 to 64.
                              Template searches accept template_id for direct binding and
                              return template:// references. See docs/blueprint.md for the
                              schema.
          --import TEXT       Import a local media file as a resource. Value MUST be a
                              local:///<abs-path> URI.
          --update TEXT       JSON resource updates. Existing records are merged; set
                              create_missing=true to upsert host-owned records.
          --sync              Read the current workspace resource_map.json and return Materials
                              XML / JSON.
          --format TEXT Needs: --sync 
                              Output format for --sync: json, xml, or both.
          --asset-id TEXT Needs: --import 
                              Optional stable asset_id for --import. Existing path dedup
                              entries are aliased atomically when safe.
          --title TEXT Needs: --import 
                              Optional human-readable title for --import. Defaults to the
                              generated asset_id when omitted.
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  # Resolve material search tasks (JSON returned; no workspace needed)
  $ lyra-cli draft blueprint resource --search '{"search":[{"type":"sticker","keyword":"flower"}]}'
  # Same search, writing results into a workspace's resource_map.json
  $ lyra-cli draft blueprint resource --workspace ./bp_ws --search '{"search":[...]}'
  # Bind a template by its native template ID (no generic resource_id needed)
  $ lyra-cli draft blueprint resource --workspace ./bp_ws --search '{"search":[{"type":"template","template_id":"7659082237807217944"}]}'
  # Search, derive frames, analyze beats, and run ASR in one call
  $ lyra-cli draft blueprint resource --workspace ./bp_ws --search '{"concurrency":{"frame":16,"beats":16,"asr":16,"understand":16},"search":[...],"frame":[{"material_id":"video1","time_ms":1500,"original_resolution":false}],"beats":[{"material_id":"music1","level":4}],"asr":[{"material_id":"music1","source_language_code":"ja-JP","translate_language_code":"zh-CN","subtitle_source":3}]}'
  # Discover semantic SAM3 masks and persist them as Blueprint resources
  $ lyra-cli draft blueprint resource --workspace ./bp_ws --search '{"sam3_region_discover":[{"material_id":"image1","prompt":"person","regions":[{"id":"subject"}],"include_remainder":true}]}'
  # Import a local media file as a resource
  $ lyra-cli draft blueprint resource --workspace ./bp_ws --import local:///abs/path/clip.mp4 --title my_clip
  # Read the latest Materials XML / resource_map from a workspace
  $ lyra-cli draft blueprint resource --workspace ./bp_ws --sync --format both

NOTE: exactly one of --search / --import / --update / --sync. Generate/frame/beat/ASR/understand/SAM3 processing, import, update, and sync require --workspace. Material understanding and SAM3 also require an available runtime provider.

LEARN MORE
  Use this command to fill resource_map.json before `draft blueprint apply`.
